description: Remove native subagent execution and retain current collaboration ownership
changelog: Remove native role generation, context dispatch hooks, Codex modes and virtual states, Pi child execution and OpenCode role materialization. Preserve main-session context, optional manifests, ordinary check Skills and current Teamwork/Paseo roles.
notes: Run native trellis update after upgrading the CLI. Ownership-aware retirement uses existing backups and blocks modified, unknown, skipped or unsafe retired execution assets. Native restore cannot reactivate retired executors. No legacy mode or dispatch compatibility remains.
